changes_made.explanation: Normalized task names to standard forms, removed redundant 'Other:' prefixes, and consolidated duplicate datasets. Wav2Vec 2.0 and wav2vec2-base-960h refer to the same model, so kept the canonical name.
The paper uses Shapley Taylor interaction indices (STII) as an interpretability method, not as an evaluation metric for generated outputs. No standard NLG evaluation metrics are used.
No LLMs are used as judges or evaluators in this paper.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on model interpretability using Shapley interactions to understand how language models represent linguistic structure, rather than evaluating NLG outputs. While it studies NLG models (GPT-2 for text generation, Wav2Vec 2.0 for speech recognition), the evaluation is of model internal representations, not generated outputs. The STII method is used for interpretability analysis, not as an NLG evaluation metric.
